review_lane: independent source-only QA review; zero authorship of reviewed changes; no test, browser, native, or product execution

addressed.obligation: An asynchronous response-body resolution after cleanup must not mutate facts.
addressed.evidence: onPaused checks closed after Fetch.getResponseBody resolves; cleanup closes first and removes listeners. The retained test snapshots facts at cleanup, resolves the body afterward, emits a terminal event, and asserts facts are unchanged.

addressed.obligation: Held requests, interception disable, and CDP detach must all be attempted even when an earlier continuation fails.
addressed.evidence: cleanup independently catches each held continuation, then attempts Fetch.disable and detach. The retained cancellation test proves the current continuation and cleanup retry occur after old release rejection; the late-resolution test proves an in-flight held response is continued before disable and detach.

addressed.obligation: Disable and detach failures must remain unverified, use safe fixed error categories, and not prevent the later teardown attempt.
addressed.evidence: Separate retained fault controls inject each failure, assert the later cleanup call, assert cleanup and assessment remain unverified, and ensure secret-bearing error text is absent from facts.

addressed.obligation: A rejected in-flight body read after cleanup must not mutate facts.
addressed.evidence: The catch branch returns when closed, so source guards rejection as well as resolution. The retained late-settlement test covers only resolution; it does not reject Fetch.getResponseBody after cleanup and assert facts remain unchanged.

not_addressed.obligation: Correct the native scenario so the prior-document request is already pending before the new saved replay begins, without the extra post-pause navigation.
not_addressed.evidence: The commit changes only the preflight helper, its unit test, evidence, and repair report. tests/browser/showcase-d47-public-initial-load.mjs still runs the saved pattern, awaits oldPaused(), then calls page.goto(pageUrl) before currentPaused() (around lines 582-606). This is the previously identified double-navigation sequence and remains unsuitable for a native retry.

verdict_a_cleanup_obligations.scope_boundary: D47 remains closed at its original bounded scope. The broader T57 remains unverified. This review does not establish native readiness or authorize a native run.

positive: The late-resolution regression is meaningful: it holds Fetch.getResponseBody pending through cleanup, verifies the held request is continued and teardown completes, then proves no fact changes after late resolution and a terminal event.
Separate disable and detach fault controls check later cleanup attempts, fixed categories, secret redaction, and an unverified final result.
The earlier cancellation control covers old release failure, current release attempt, cleanup retry of the old hold, disable, and detach.

The supplied guarded evidence has matching source/test and final stdout/journal SHA-256 values. The earlier retained run exposed the incorrect held-response label; the final retained run records 9 passed and 0 failed. These logs were inspected, not rerun.

gaps.finding: The final suite has a late resolution control but no corresponding late rejection control. The implementation catch guard appears correct, but the regression does not prove rejection leaves facts unchanged after cleanup.
gaps.needed: Add a retained negative control that rejects Fetch.getResponseBody only after cleanup has completed, then asserts the serialized facts remain unchanged and cleanup stays unverified.

gaps.finding: The accepted repair report says no acceptance-scenario change was attempted, and the old post-pause page.goto remains. The broader T57 sequence still performs the incorrect double navigation called out by the prior peer.
gaps.needed: Correct and independently review the scenario before any native retry; keep native readiness unclaimed until a separate authorized exact-artifact run establishes the required evidence.

verdict_b_evidence_and_source_quality.runtime_limit: No test, browser, native app, or product runtime was launched in this review.

overall: The cleanup source and most retained failure controls address the prior cleanup race. The late rejection branch lacks a matching regression, and the incorrect double-navigation scenario remains. Do not claim native readiness; T57 stays unverified.
